HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE JASMEET SINGH  ORDER % 15.02.2023
This is a petition filed seeking quashing of the FIR No. 1240/2015 dated 05.10.2015 registered at PS Janak Puri under Section 498A/406/34 IPC.

The parties have arrived at a settlement dated 27.11.2021 before the Mediation Centre, Dwarka Courts, Delhi, pursuant to which the petitioner had to pay a sum of Rs. 50,000/- to the respondent No.2 which stands already paid.

The petitioner is present in Court through video conferencing mode and has been identified by Mr.
Pankaj Singh, learned counsel.
The respondent No.2 is also present in Court and has been identified by SI Usha Mehlawat, PS Janak Puri.
The parties state that they have arrived at the aforesaid settlement out of their own free will and without any undue influence, threat, pressure or coercion.
The respondent No.2 states that she has no objection if the present FIR is quashed.
There is one child who is in the care and custody of the petitioner No.1 (father).
It is directed that the settlement and this order shall not come in the way of the child claiming his rights of inheritance, maintenance, education, marriage etc. against any of the parties.
In view of the aforesaid, the FIR No. 1240/2015 dated 05.10.2015 registered at PS Janak Puri under Section 498A/406/34 IPC and all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom are hereby quashed.
